$comment: Open work toward the first live event, taken from ROADMAP.md on 2026-11-07. Agents may only set 'passes' to true, and only after verification (make check output, plus Jakub's result in docs/hardware-test.md where 'needs_hardware' is true). Jakub adds and edits items. Done features and the full matrix: ROADMAP.md and replica/features.csv. Acceptance criteria were drafted from ROADMAP.md and the spec by an agent on 2026-11-07; Jakub confirms or edits them before an item is built.

features.title: Rehearsal on the event laptop with projector and real buzzers
features.roadmap: Phase 4: Rehearsal on the event laptop
acceptance: A whole demo show runs on the Windows event laptop with the 303S receiver, every buzzer in the room, and the projector on the second monitor
The crash drill on that laptop (kill mid-question, restart, resume) continues the show with scores and buzz queue intact
Results are written into docs/hardware-test.md

features.title: 303S protocol checked with every buzzer, high buzzer numbers and macOS
acceptance: Buzzers far apart in ID (e.g. 1 and 64) register and order correctly in a fastest-finger question
Two buzzers pressed at once are ordered by their own timers in the app
The receiver works on macOS as on Windows 11

features.title: Buzzer lights and custom colours readable from the back of a room
acceptance: Ready, answered, waiting, first, correct and wrong are told apart from the back of the hall
Colours other than the defaults show as the nearest shade the Receiver tab predicts

features.title: Buzz queue on the hardware
features.roadmap: M2: Every fastest-finger buzz waits its turn
acceptance: With real buzzers, a wrong answer passes the question to the next team in the buzzers' order with the clock still stopped
Answering, waiting and wrong teams light white, yellow and red until the question ends

features.title: Remote arrow keys checked on the hardware
acceptance: The codes of the remote's three arrow keys are confirmed with hid-monitor and drive their chosen actions in a show

features.title: Read questions aloud on the Windows event laptop
acceptance: The voice model downloads, and a question is read aloud in Czech on the event laptop, with the clock behaving as specified

features.title: Round scores on the end-of-round slide
features.roadmap: M1: Leaderboard and final scores; round scores to do
acceptance: Open question first: ROADMAP.md lists round scores as to do, while README.md lists end-of-round scores; Jakub confirms what the end-of-round slide must show
The end-of-round slide shows each team's points for that round and the running total, computed in quiz-core (results.rs already groups questions by round)
game_flow.rs covers a two-round show; a preview scene shows the slide in Czech and English

features.title: Slide transitions on the projector
acceptance: Jakub decides which transitions and where they are chosen (quiz, slide or theme)
A transition never delays the journal write or the next command

features.title: Windows E2E green on main
features.roadmap: Phase 4: End-to-end tests (red on main for now)
acceptance: The Windows E2E job of build.yml passes on main
No test is skipped or loosened to get there

features.title: Event checklist
acceptance: docs/ has a checklist for the event: laptop power, display settings, receiver, spare batteries, backup quiz file, update installed before the day

features.title: Fallback: vendor keystroke mode through the keyboard driver
acceptance: If the receiver cannot be opened, a receiver in keystroke mode drives the show through the keyboard buzzers
